phase: External Source Screening — Sectoral Financial Positions
purpose: Screen official sources outside the already exhausted retained ECB-QSA query path for a possible future source-reopen trigger. Screening does not change the reference-mode target, accounting state or readiness and does not treat a new dissemination layer as independent evidence without source-lineage review.

stocks.title: Quarterly Financial Balance Sheets (stocks) - counterpart information

positive_evidence: OECD explicitly describes both quarterly counterpart-position and counterpart-flow tables by institutional sector and financial instrument.
The OECD Data Explorer exposes SDMX API endpoints for both dataflows.
The counterpart tables can in principle represent relationships between non-financial corporations, financial corporations, government, households/NPISH and rest of world by instrument.
lineage_boundary: OECD states that Quarterly Sector Accounts (financial part) are an OECD-ECB collection.
Therefore an OECD observation is not assumed to be statistically independent from the ECB/European financial-accounts source chain.
A future retained Romania result must record its source metadata/lineage before it can count as a source-reopen trigger.

access_operational_context.interpretation: Provider throttling/access failures are INDETERMINATE and cannot be treated as absent Romania data.

positive_evidence: Eurostat quarterly financial-flows/stocks metadata explicitly identifies nasq_10_f_cp as Financial accounts: counterpart information.
The mandatory core quarterly dataset includes who-to-whom tables for deposits and short-term/long-term loans, with mandatory backdata from 2012-Q4.
Counterpart-sector details for securities are mandatory from 2013-Q4.
The reference area covers all EU Member States and dissemination frequency is quarterly.
lineage_boundary: Quarterly financial-account data are reported to the ECB, validated there and transmitted to Eurostat for republication.
Therefore Eurostat is not assumed to be a statistically independent source from the existing European financial-accounts chain.
Its scientific value here is potential access to an explicit counterpart dissemination table that was not yet retained in the RMD source-recovery chain.
scope_limit: Metadata does not establish complete mandatory counterpart coverage for every RMD instrument F2-F8.
No conclusion about Romania row-level availability, sector mapping, units, counterpart orientation or instrument completeness is allowed before a retained probe.

decision.next_admissible_action: Preserve both strengthened external discovery probes as manual-only. Eurostat nasq_10_f_cp remains first priority; OECD counterpart stocks/flows remain secondary. Execute either only after its workflow definition is present on the default branch or through an equivalent explicitly authorized manual path; do not broaden triggers to pull_request/push merely to obtain live source data. Provider/network/throttling failures are indeterminate and have no scientific effect. A retained PASS authorizes only a separately preregistered lineage/semantic/instrument-coverage review, never direct reference-mode promotion.
